summary: Unlock your potential as a leader with our Managing People and Teams Course. Acquire the tools and techniques to effectively manage and empower your team.
lede: People and team management training helps new and developing managers turn team goals into coordinated work. It covers diagnosing team needs and delegating effectively, setting performance measures with OKRs and KPIs, and using feedback and coaching to support development. Learners also practise handling conflict, building engagement, and coordinating communication across distributed teams.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals transitioning into leadership or those seeking to formalize their management approach with globally recognized frameworks.
prerequisites: Participants should currently hold a supervisory role or be scheduled to move into a management position within the next six months. Familiarity with basic organizational structures and performance review processes is recommended.
